verdict.rationale: Pipedream's trigger docs list HTTP / Webhook as a first-class trigger type alongside Schedule, Email and RSS. Selecting a test event and sending its data into the workflow shows that trigger event payloads flow into runs. A community thread independently confirms HTTP triggers exist, noting limits of a 100kb max body, 10 req/s and 10s execution, which are real constraints on payload handling. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of the generated unique webhook URL, details on how request body/headers/query are exposed to workflow steps, and custom response handling.
